title: Depth gallery
description: Two to six pictures float at different depths and the camera flies forward through the space (CSS 3D) until they settle in an asymmetric editorial layout; inside each frame the picture keeps drifting slowly, so the depth stays alive. Captions are real text with gold numbers.
